method: Fresh source observations recorded before full sample-value comparison; not fully blinded: initial handoff/sample read exposed some saved values. Reviewer is this task's agent, not a human or statistically independent second reviewer.

observations.note: Private/public API keys and OAuth; managing keys requires Owner/Admin/Manager; scoped keys and resource endpoints documented.
Admin GraphQL carries access tokens and scopes; app distribution determines review. Public app approval does not gate every custom integration.
OAuth-based store/app/account credentials; app install grant creates access token; alternate endpoint auth differs.
Application registration and selling-partner authorization precede access; LWA refresh-token/client-credentials routes and restricted data tokens documented.
API key is separate from CLI login. Platform now says all plans including free/trial; Tables structured queries need Enterprise sync; Windows unsupported.
GitHub organization repository calls itself official; remote MCP hosted by GitHub. REST supports PAT/app/Actions tokens and unauthenticated limited calls.
Atlas Administration API supports recommended OAuth service accounts and legacy digest keys; roles and project organization membership required; excludes cluster data.
Linear centrally hosts and manages its MCP; GraphQL supports personal API keys/OAuth2 with endpoint and example queries/mutations.
Personal V2 token issued from developer center; user permissions mirrored; app tokens scoped; free developer account for testing.
Stripe describes own remote MCP; resource API keys use Basic or bearer delivery; Dashboard keys and test calls documented.
Migration blog distinguishes current SAT from planned M2M OAuth; legacy keys continue. Migration alone is not proof of API unbuildability.
Separate standalone API contract; Direct Data request; API key or authentication token. Outreach readiness, not self-service certification.
Web tool empty, browser rendered OAuth2 REST documentation, application registration/token generation, scopes and resource methods. Prior capture limitation recoverable.
Browser renders Commas docs explicitly naming fanbasis.com production APIs; x-api-key header and Account/API Keys onboarding. Product-name mapping limited to this documented domain.
gopaygent.com browser mentions Paygent Connect but assigned NMI-powered/paygent.io identity still not deterministically matched; generic same-name vendors not interchangeable.
Docs/developer opens fail; browser docs timed out. No current readable assigned-product authentication/resource evidence recovered.
Private access token versus public OAuth; public installs reviewed, private own paid workspace exempt. MCP URL failed web opening; browser recovery needed.
OAuth authorization-code route and private integration static bearer tokens documented; API v1 keys end-of-life; service-account classification not established.
OAuth plus static auth supported; scope/tier entitlement matters. UI content approvals/payment exports must not be imported as generic API onboarding gates.
REST official guide documents resource CRUD and OAuth onboarding. General blog does not alone establish business logic/AI agent endpoint breadth; more specific routes required.
